flagged_bins.sample_level_se_method: Approximate self-normalized ratio delta-method SE, using exactly replayed saved samples. For each independent repetition: Var(Hhat) = N/(N-1) * sum_i[w_i^2 (I_i-Hhat)^2] / (sum_i w_i)^2. The variance of the mean of B repetitions is sum_b Var(Hhat_b)/B^2; variances from the independent direct and canonical streams are added. This post-run diagnostic is not a confidence certificate and does not replace the original regression threshold or acceptance result.
